notes: Edit this file to change what the pipeline tracks; no code changes needed.
A collection's trials are the union (deduplicated by NCT number) of its queries' results.
Within one query, the cond / intr / spons fields are ANDed together, exactly as ClinicalTrials.gov combines its Condition, Intervention and Sponsor search boxes. Terms inside one field are ORed.
Terms are sent as written; a term containing anything other than letters and digits is quoted as a phrase.
study_type applies to every query unless a query sets its own. INTERVENTIONAL = clinical trials (people are assigned a treatment); observational studies are excluded.
Changing a collection's queries re-baselines that collection on the next run: trials that newly match because of the edit are not reported as new_trial events.
sponsors_of_note are display metadata (trial badges, later company pages). They also feed each collection's sponsor query, which is limited to the collection's conditions.

collections.name: GLP-1 & obesity
collections.why_it_matters: GLP-1 medicines such as semaglutide and tirzepatide changed how obesity is treated, and the next wave of these drugs is in trials now.

collections.name: Type 2 diabetes
collections.why_it_matters: South Asians develop type 2 diabetes earlier and at lower body weights than other groups — this collection exists for the family as much as the portfolio.

collections.name: Cholesterol & lipid disorders
collections.why_it_matters: High LDL ("bad") cholesterol is a major driver of heart attacks and strokes, and newer drug classes beyond statins are being tested to lower it.
